name: Rumbleshot's Ammo
summary: Near the Grizzled Den, Rumbleshot's Ammo lies abandoned in the snow. The crate was bound for gunsmith Hegnar Rumbleshot in Dun Morogh, but a frightened courier fled from hungry wendigos and left it behind.

sections.title: A Stranded Shipment
sections.body: Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a roadside arms shop on the mountain path from Coldridge Pass toward Anvilmar. Ironforge riflemen, mountaineers, and dwarven mortar teams drill in the snowy heights, and his supplies run low as quickly as powder burns. Loslor sent this shipment of shot from Kharanos, but it never reached the shelves. Its courier camped too close to the Grizzled Den's wendigos. When they attacked, the courier panicked and fled, leaving the heavy crate in the beasts' hunting grounds.

faq.answer: Hegnar Rumbleshot is a dwarven gunsmith with a shop off the road toward Anvilmar. He supplies local marksmen, hunters, and military gunners, who use munitions while practicing in Dun Morogh's crags.

faq.q: How did the ammo crate get lost?
faq.answer: A courier carrying the crate camped near the Grizzled Den. When its wendigos attacked, the frightened courier fled and left the heavy crate in the snow.
The Grizzled Den is a cavern system in the mountains southwest of Kharanos. Dun Morogh's wendigos make their lair there, putting solitary travelers on the surrounding slopes in danger.

angles.text: As a hunter in Dun Morogh, keep Hegnar's powder dry and shot stocked for a steady supply of ammunition for dwarven firearms.
As an engineer, you rely on shot and powder to test crafted firearms and experimental weaponry.
